inherits_m31_manifest.o_proj: excluded from allocation AND quantization (fp16 in all configs); reason: per-head PCA path only exists in AV representation

formats.main: nvfp4 blk16 (two-level E4M3 scale, act-MSE search steps=3 fast)

inherits_m31_manifest.fit: wikitext2-train 512x2048 seed0 window sequence; score collection = first 2 windows (4096 tokens, all projections same token positions); GPTQ = first 128 windows (prefix subset)
inherits_m31_manifest.heldout: 32x2048 wikitext2-train windows, seed 31001, rejected overlap with the 512 fit windows; offsets recorded per run json
inherits_m31_manifest.ppl: wiki test full (seqlen2048, equal windows => window-mean == token-mean NLL), C4 val 256 windows seed0; input sha in run jsons

gptq.env_defaults: PROMIX_ACT_MSE=1 steps3 fast, PROMIX_WEIGHT_MSE=1 steps3, PROMIX_WEIGHT_2LEVEL=1 (metricsweep main-curve protocol)

inherits_m31_manifest.error_metric: E_l=SSE/(ENERGY+1e-12) on teacher inputs, float64 accumulation; mean/std over eligible layers ddof=0 (between-layer spread)

mask: frozen M31 AV-within allocation (scores/{3b,8b}_pca.pt + deterministic top-h, ties->lower channel id); Direct and Rotated share the SAME mask per (model, ratio); per-ratio alloc_hash in run jsons; direct_reuse_verification_{3b,8b}.json: all_match=True (alloc_hash + representation + recipe vs the M31 runs, not just PPL)

conditions.direct: M31 av_within runs reused for E/PPL; A/magnitude measured by stats32 on the float PCA twin
conditions.rotated: per-Linear blockdiag(R_low,R_high) on packed layout; R=float64 Gaussian->QR->diag-sign; weights V_g R_g in fp64 on GPU; activations Z_g R_g at runtime in fp16 (common compute dtype); explicit reference implementation, non-zero overhead

ratios: 0.1..0.9 target (actual quotas as in M31); r=0/1 single-format contrasts live in M31 runs, not labeled as two-group mixed
seeds: rotation_seed 0 main; 1,2 at r in {0.1,0.5,0.9}; fit seed 0; Direct not duplicated per seed

stats.A: SSE/(ENERGY+1e-12) float64 on teacher Z-prime per group; layer-equal mean/std ddof=0, H and L separate
stats.magnitude: abs quantiles p50/90/99/99.9 (reservoir<=200k per module-group, seed 320001) + exact max; block max/RMS (blk16/32) quantiles (reservoir<=100k) + zero-block count; group ENERGY for Direct/Rotated energy-ratio check; representative modules layers {2,L//2,L-3} x {q_proj,down_proj} with 101-point quantile curves
